en: Color postcard showing a pink, one‑to‑two‑storey historic building with a tiled gable roof and arched entrances in the center. A small tower-like central section has a clock above a doorway. Flower boxes line the balcony, and several bicycles are parked on the right. The scene is framed by large trees and a shaded foreground square or yard. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
